result:
Both of my sub-tasks, PLAT-104-3 (core shell) and PLAT-104-4 (reports), are live. I marked them done on the board.

- **PR:** I opened one PR for both, PR #3. CI passed, I merged it, and CD on main succeeded.
- **Change:** `libs/shared-contracts` lives in this repo and is inlined into each app at build time, so no registry release or dependency bump was needed. Each app only needed a rebuild after dev-a's `billingUrl` change (`https://homelab.local/billing/v2`) landed. CD only rebuilds an app when something under its own directory changes. So I bumped `version` from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1 in `apps/core-shell/package.json` and `apps/sub-route-reports/package.json`.
- **Coordination:** I told dev-a about the inlining and the change-detection catch, then waited for their PLAT-104-1 merge message. dev-a had already found the same thing. I pulled main and confirmed `billingUrl` was the new value before starting.
- **Surprises:** The docs say CD only builds the shell and billing, but `Jenkinsfile.cd` also handles reports, so the docs are out of date. I didn't verify the deployed files directly. I only saw CD report success.

I assumed one PR for both tasks was fine, since the repo's contributing guide prefers one PR per ticket.
